messages:
sasha: Hey team — ran onboarding for 'neox-17B-quant' and the bench failed with KV cache misalignment on long prompts. Logs show RuntimeError when seq_len > 2048. Repro steps attached.

matt: ugh. can you paste the short log lines? which backend (triton/pytorch)?

sasha: Triton on dedicated staging. Log excerpt:
```
RuntimeError: KVCacheIndexOutOfRange: idx 2049 > max 2048
 at runtime/kv_cache.cc:142
```

anita: that looks like an off-by-one in cache sharding. we've hit similar after the shard-padding tweak last month. Do we have a validator that runs a long-prefix smoke? thought ingest ran a seq_len stress test.

sasha: we have 'prefix-smoke' but it tops out at 1k tokens. This case used ~6k tokens. model metadata said "max_seq":8192 but per-shard buffer defaulted to 2048.

luis: immediate mitigation: fallback to a compatible variant with unified KV layout or to non-sharded runtime. Longer term: add a compatibility check that compares model metadata (kv_layout + shard_stride) against runtime defaults. If mismatch, auto-annotate and optionally fallback.

anita: agreed. tradeoffs: fallback keeps apps online but latency can jump. we should surface a console signal: "onboard-warning: degraded latency due to fallback". also add an admit gate: reject models advertising max_seq > runtime_cap unless kv_layout flag present.

sasha: proposed action items: 1) short stress test that exercises >2048 tokens with synthetic prefixes, 2) metadata validator for kv_layout and shard config, 3) automatic fallback policy documented and instrumented. comments?

matt: +1. stress test should be isolated and low-resource: run on a single microshard, small batch sizes. add perf-review: if fallback causes p95 latency >2x, block hosted default route and require dedicated or explicit opt-in.

deploy-bot: Canary job started for 2106789012-fix-kvcache-check (status: queued)

anita: also update the model registry UI to show "compatibility hints" on ingest: e.g., "kv_layout mismatch with default-serving: requires runtime flag --kv-unified true" so SEs see issues before promoting.

luis: I'll prototype the validator: compare model.json fields ["max_seq","kv_layout","shard_stride","tokenizer_version"] against a compatibility matrix. If mismatch -> annotate as 'requires-runtime-config' with remediation text. I'll open a PR with tests.

sasha: tl;dr: add >2048 stress test, metadata validator for kv layout, registry annotation, fallback path, perf-gate for hosted route. owners?

anita: I'll own the stress test and registry UI changes.

matt: I'll own perf-gate thresholds and rollout policy.

luis: validator + PR.

sasha: thanks — please ping when PRs are up. :thumbsup:
